capabilities: set per-folder sort rules in settings
sort files and subfolders with independent orders
apply rules recursively to nested subfolders
reorder files and subfolders manually via drag and drop
resolve the most specific matching rule per folder
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Override the global file explorer sorting with independent rules for files and subfolders.
problem: Obsidian only offers one global sort order for the file explorer, so folders with different content types cannot be sorted differently.
summary: Sort-order manager that defines per-folder sorting rules in the file explorer, with independent ordering for files and subfolders.
